svg.aria-label: Search autocomplete final design. Offline: search logs flow into Kafka, an aggregation job counts queries over a sliding window with decay, filters offensive or rare queries, and builds a trie in which every node stores its top 10 completions. The trie is serialized and loaded into memory on suggest servers, sharded by prefix range and replicated. Online: the client waits for a short pause in typing, checks its local cache, then calls through the CDN and load balancer to a suggest server, which walks the trie to the prefix node and returns its precomputed top 10 in about a millisecond. Trending queries are added by a faster streaming path.
